title: I bought a tileset s pack but i can't use it.

posts.author: Dan7531
posts.body:
This is the pack i bought:
https://limezu.itch.io/modernexteriors
i copied the "Modern_Exteriors_Complete_Tileset_48x48.png" and pasted it inside my RPG MZ tilesets folder to use it, inside the program i went to Database -> Tilesets and created a new one containing the png in one of the 9 empty slots, but when i tried to use the tilesets i noticed that the map editor only lets me use a tiny part of the png (only lets me use what is in the image im showing).
Im a complete novice at using RPG so i don´t get if this happens because the program only accepts a certain ammount of tilesets, after all the Modern exteriors png contains all the tilesets (that are a lot) in just 1 png, and if i want to add the tilesets separately i find that all the tilesets (5.660 elements ) are separated 1 by 1 by searching the tileset folder"singles" but RPG MZ tileset database only accepts 9. i searched around and didn´t find any "Modern_Exteriors_A1", "A2" and the like to insert each to their corresponding slots.
I also tried downloading the Modern Exteriors RPG MV but its tilesets are also separated in a total of 120 groups, im lost.

posts.author: Meirothemaze
posts.body: Doesn't the DLC come with a sample project? Most DLCs usually come with sample projects, so maybe you could check how it works there.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
most likely you placed the tilesheet in the wrong slot of the tileset.
there are six different formats for tilesheets, and each ONLY works in the slot intended for that format.
The formats are usually named A1 to A5 for the five formats combining as the A-sheet, and the sixth format is for the B to E slots.
You can read more details on the tilesheet formats in the help file under asset standards.

Yes, that's how tilesets work. You have separate tilesets for your mountain map, cave map, beach map, museum map, etc. You can't have all tilesets loaded at once as it would cause performance issues.

posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body:
You'll never be able to put all of them in ONE massive tileset. For starters the game would never load, nor would your engine anymore if you did somehow pull it off. Some very quick off the cuff math says you would need terabytes of memory to load all of them into memory at once. I don't think you got that, nor do you want to make that your requirements to play your game.
And that is not going into the engine limits. You have to pick what you need from A1 - A5 and B - E.
Many have different tileset tabs in the database to use different combinations.

Just one more correction:
A does NOT stand for animation, it stands for Autotile.
Only A1 contains animated autotiles, A2 to A4 are different combinations of non-animated autotiles and A5 is regular tiles (for compatibility issues, they are only needed in VXAce and MV because in those engines A-tiles can only placed on the ground and B-E tiles only in the upper layers)

posts.author: fizzly
posts.body: This is how RPG Maker works, you can't use all 120 tilesets in one map. That's what tilesets are for. Yo uneed to organize them to use them on different maps depending on your needs.
